required_check.source: GitHub Actions custom check run on the exact PR head

preconditions: Human/Ops gives explicit authorization for the named branch and exact captured baseline.
canonical-review-gate.yml is already merged into the target branch; dev and master are activated separately after the workflow exists on each branch.
.github/canonical-review-keys.json has been populated by a separately reviewed bootstrap PR; the shipped empty registry intentionally fails closed.
Each reviewer signer key is absolute, mode 0600, outside the repository and status root, and exposed only to the protected governed command runtime.
A canary PR has produced the exact check name from GitHub Actions app id 15368 within the last seven days.
The scheduled re-evaluation has been observed updating an open canary so attestation expiry and key revocation cannot leave a stale success.
A fresh full protection response, scoped required-review response, enforce-admin response, repository response, and ruleset response have been captured after any external freeze/release operation.
The freshly generated plan preserves every unrelated status check and writes rollback payloads before activation.

activation_order.reason: Block UI and GraphQL auto-merge creation; approved gated tasks merge only through exact-head integrator.
Make branch requirements apply to the shared admin credential.

body_contract.checks: preserve every fresh baseline check and append exactly one {context: Pantheon canonical reviewer attestation, app_id: 15368}

activation_order.reason: Only the Actions-app check produced by the trusted-base verifier can satisfy the new merge requirement.

must_prove: exact context occurs once with app_id 15368
all pre-existing required checks are unchanged
missing, rejected, stale-head, forged, expired, and self-owned attestations produce a failing exact-head check

rollback.trigger: Any missing/unreadable key registry, wrong app id, lost pre-existing check, canary false pass, merge bypass, or workflow outage.
order: PATCH the branch required_status_checks endpoint with the exact fresh pre-activation strict/checks payload.
Restore enforce_admins with POST or DELETE exactly as recorded in the fresh baseline.
PATCH repository allow_auto_merge to the exact fresh baseline value.
Read back full protection, scoped required reviews, enforce_admins, repository settings, and rulesets; compare with the baseline digest.
rollback.warning: The 2026-07-28 dev baseline changed during capture. Never execute rollback from this committed example; regenerate it immediately before an authorized activation.
